Abhishek Sharma Praises Sanju Samson's Selfless Gesture After India's T20I Series Win Over New Zealand

01 Nov 2026, 08:03 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

Image: The Times of India · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9 for the website

Key takeaways India Secures Unassailable Series Lead India claimed a six-wicket victory against New Zealand in the third T20I on Tuesday, securing an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series. Playing away, New Zealand batted first and posted 198/3, anchored by Daryl Mitchell'

India Secures Unassailable Series Lead

India claimed a six-wicket victory against New Zealand in the third T20I on Tuesday, securing an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series. Playing away, New Zealand batted first and posted 198/3, anchored by Daryl Mitchell's unbeaten 89 off 52 balls and Finn Allen's 40. In response, India successfully chased the target in 13.2 overs, finishing at 198-plus with 40 balls remaining.

Batting Reshuffle and Record Partnership

A notable talking point from the completed fixture was a tactical change at the top of the Indian order. Wicketkeeper-batter Sanju Samson—who won the Player of the Match award for a score of 61 in the second T20I—relinquished his opening position to allow teenage batter Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to open the innings alongside Abhishek Sharma.

Abhishek lauded Samson's decision in a post-match interaction facilitated by BCCI.TV, noting the difficulty of giving up a familiar spot after a strong individual performance.

  • Abhishek Sharma: Scored 113 off 38 deliveries, reaching his century in 35 balls with nine fours and 11 sixes.
  • Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: Contributed 45 off 19 deliveries following his promotion to the opening slot.
  • Opening Partnership: Put on 133 runs in just seven overs, propelling India to 118 without loss during the Powerplay.

Practical Implications and Verification

With the victory, India has won the five-match series with two games remaining. Fans and analysts looking to verify the original match details, official statistics, and player statements can consult official cricket boards such as BCCI.TV or verified sports broadcast networks covering the India tour of New Zealand.
